# Skuuy Edge Speedtest & Bufferbloat Lab (speed.skuuy.com)

> speed.skuuy.com is a free, privacy-first internet speed testing suite, bufferbloat responsiveness auditor, and global gaming ping matrix.
> Part of the decentralized Skuuy Tools ecosystem (https://skuuy.com).
> Leverages multi-stream Web Workers querying Cloudflare Edge PoPs directly using HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 multiplexing.
> 100% Free Forever, no tracking cookies, zero intrusive popups, zero connection throttling.

## Diagnostic Capabilities

- [Edge Speed Engine](https://speed.skuuy.com/): Real-time multi-stream download and upload throughput measurement without browser UI freezing.
- [Bufferbloat Responsiveness Audit](https://speed.skuuy.com/#bufferbloat): Measures unloaded idle ping vs loaded ping under heavy download/upload saturation, assigning a letter grade (A+ through F) and RPM score per Apple & IETF RFC 8290 standards.
- [Global Gaming & Cloud Cluster Matrix](https://speed.skuuy.com/#gaming): Parallel real-time latency and jitter benchmarks to 15+ major gaming hubs (Singapore, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Sydney, Frankfurt, London, US West, US East).
- [Real-World Application Index](https://speed.skuuy.com/): Instant validation for 4K/8K 60fps streaming, Discord screen-sharing, Zoom multi-party conferences, and Cloud Gaming (GeForce NOW).
- [Shareable Speed Certificate](https://speed.skuuy.com/): 1-click generation of high-contrast Neo-Brutalist speed cards and Markdown badges for GitHub profiles.
